Data category: Patient file / medical record (including acknowledgement statements, referrals and medical letters)
Starts from: From the last consultation. For minors: from the age of majority – to be confirmed.
Legal basis / criterion: Health and archiving rules applicable to the practice (for example the National Archives Law no. 16/1996 and Ministry of Health acts on medical documentation). The exact act and period have not been verified. 10 years is a recommendation until the clinic confirms it with the public health authority, the professional college or a legal adviser.
At end of period: Secure destruction, with a record. Electronic: permanent deletion from the application and from backups.

Data category: Accounting and tax documents (invoices, receipts, registers, supporting documents, claim and reporting documents)
Starts from: From 1 July of the year after the financial year in which the documents were drawn up.
Legal basis / criterion: Art. 25(1) of the Accounting Law no. 82/1991, as amended by Law no. 36/2023: 5 years from 1 July of the year after the end of the financial year (previously 10 years). Exception: supporting documents for assets with a useful life longer than 5 years are kept for that useful life (Ministry of Public Finance Order no. 1447/2023). Last checked 7 November 2026; the accountant confirms the current text and any document with a different period.
At end of period: Secure destruction, with a record. The accountant deletes the copies it holds, at the clinic's request.

Legal basis / criterion: For employees: Art. 5 of Law no. 190/2018 – proportionate to the purpose, no more than 30 days, with the exceptions in law or in well-justified cases. ANSPDCP Decision no. 52/2012: the draft text seen sets a 30-day maximum; the final text is to be confirmed. EDPB Guidelines 3/2019: normally a few days. Images exported for an incident are kept only as long as the investigation lasts or the authorities require.
At end of period: Automatic deletion by overwriting. Exports are deleted when the case closes and entered in the destruction register.

Starts from: From the date of the appointment.
Legal basis / criterion: No legal period. Criterion: operational usefulness (rebooking, complaints) and data minimisation. The consultation itself is recorded in the medical record (RET-01). The practice software keeps appointments separate from the record; checked in the vendor review. Recommendation.
At end of period: Deletion from the application; messages (SMS / e-mail) at the provider, as set in the contract.

Data category: Consents and contacts for promotional communications
Period:
Contact data: until consent is withdrawn, but no more than 24 months from the last interaction or consent confirmation.
Proof of consent: 3 years from withdrawal or deletion of the contact.
Starts from: Withdrawal of consent or, if earlier, the last interaction or confirmation of consent.
Legal basis / criterion: Consent may be withdrawn at any time (Art. 7(3) GDPR) but does not justify keeping contacts without limit: storage limitation (Art. 5(1)(e)). The GDPR sets no period; 24 months is a recommendation. At expiry the contact is deleted or reconfirmation is requested. Proof is kept to defend legal claims for the general 3-year limitation period (Art. 2517 of the Romanian Civil Code). An unsubscribed address may stay on a suppression list, strictly to avoid sending further messages.
At end of period: Deletion from the contact list (or reconfirmation); proof is kept separately and deleted after 3 years.

Starts from: From the resolution of the request.
Legal basis / criterion: General limitation period of 3 years (Art. 2517 of the Civil Code); proof that the request was handled correctly. Recommendation.
